Mock test rankings came out at the coaching centre today. Uday: 14th. Me: 37th.

For two months I've given Uday my formula sheets, my solved papers, even the shortcut tricks I worked out myself. Every time he said, "Next week I'll send you my chemistry notes, Pallavi." Next week never came. Today I heard him tell the others he "figured out" the shortcuts on his own.
